name: Royal Crackers
description: Royal Crackers was once the king of snacks, but the empire is crumbling. When the family patriarch, tyrannical company founder Theodore Hornsby Sr. ends up in a “super coma,” the rest of the Hornsbys will take their lack of talent and business acumen and try to make Royal Crackers the success it once was.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes the Hornsby family when their beloved patriarch and founder of Royal Crackers, Theodore Hornsby Sr., falls into a 'super coma'.

videos.title: Theo's Comeback Tour
videos.overview: Theo kicks off his solo career by going on a world tour. Meanwhile, back at the Hornsby Manor, Stebe and Deb take the opportunity to experiment with hard drugs.

videos.title: Factory 37
videos.overview: Royal Crackers' most profitable factory is due for an inspection, but when a brand new no-nonsense health inspector arrives, the team has to work extra hard to make sure Factory 37 is up to code.

videos.title: Stebe
videos.overview: When Theo's old charismatic friend and former bandmate shows up unexpectedly at the Hornsby Manor, Stebe is thrown into a full-blown identity crisis.

videos.title: Business Mom
videos.overview: Deb becomes the target of intense internet backlash after an altercation at the local grocery store earns her widespread infamy.

videos.title: Mayworth
videos.overview: A botched birthday party makes Theodore Hornsby Sr. recount a troubling event from his past.

videos.title: The .1%
videos.overview: The Hornsby family attends a deviant billionaire's annual yacht party, which is reserved exclusively for "The .1%," the richest billionaires in the world.

videos.title: Casa de Darby
videos.overview: The Hornsby's head to Burbank, California when Stebe lands Royal Crackers a lucrative brand integration deal with a very popular Latin American sitcom, "Casa De Papa."

videos.title: CrackerCon
videos.overview: It's time for the team to head to beautiful Primm, Nevada and attend the Super Bowl for global snack food companies, "CrackerCon."

videos.title: Craftopia
videos.overview: When Matt's computer is destroyed by an internet prankster named Zane, he takes a job at Royal Crackers to save enough money to buy a replacement.

videos.title: Fight for J. Davis High
videos.overview: When Royal Crackers gets removed from school lunch for a more healthy alternative, it polarizes the town. Battle lines are drawn, and the Hornsby's find themselves fighting a war they don't know if they can win.

videos.title: Catalina
videos.overview: Stebe's bad dreams lead him and Theo on a mission to discover secrets about their father's dark past.

videos.title: MyCycle
videos.overview: Deb's new found love of riding her exercise bike drives a wedge between her and Stebe. Theo's attempt to bond with his father fails, turning him into a vulnerable mess.

videos.title: Bro Down
videos.overview: Darby can't make time to hang out with Theo because he's got a new girlfriend whom he's infatuated with, even though she might want to murder him.

videos.title: Bidai
videos.overview: When a King from half a world away invites the remaining members of TainT to perform for him, Theo, Stebe and Moey D, end up getting ensnared in a spy mission that tests their allegiances to Nu-Metal and puts all of their lives at risk.

videos.title: Tracker
videos.overview: After Matt embarrasses the family, Stebe and Theo decide to discipline him the way their father used to, by leaving him to fend for himself in the middle of nowhere.

videos.title: MALL
videos.overview: The Bakersfield Mall grand reopening quickly turns into a bloodbath because there's a haunted escalator that wants to exact revenge on Stebe.

videos.title: Rachel
videos.overview: Rachel is tasked with saving the company, but when she's called to a meeting with her family, she has to decide if she wants to save the company, or all of humanity.

videos.title: Prison
videos.overview: Stebe gets sent to white collar prison, where he quickly becomes one of the most popular inmates. However, when Theo gets locked up too, Stebe's position as the 'cool guy' comes under threat.

videos.title: Dog
videos.overview: Matt brings home a stray dog that keeps attacking Theodore Sr. Meanwhile, in the past, Young Theodore's empire begins to crumble.
